steps.en: The officer can change the vehicle type on a notice
steps.id: Officer bisa mengganti tipe kendaraan pada notice

steps.en: The new vehicle type is saved on the notice
steps.id: Tipe kendaraan baru disimpan pada notice

steps.en: The classified suspension loop stops after the change
steps.id: Siklus penangguhan classified berhenti setelah perubahan

steps.en: The notice goes back to the normal processing flow
steps.id: Notice kembali diproses dengan alur normal
steps.why_en: An active classified suspension is not lifted automatically, and it can be applied again after revival.
steps.why_id: Penangguhan classified yang aktif tidak dicabut otomatis dan bisa dipasang lagi setelah revival.
